descriptions.zh-Hans: 在伊斯坦布尔尝过simit后写的菜单，面包圈旁边还有我说到一半的路线。
descriptions.en: My simit menu from Istanbul, with a route discussion interrupted by the first bite.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在伊斯坦布尔吃过烤鱼三明治后留下的菜单，菜名下有一句给自己的提醒：先拿稳。
descriptions.en: A menu after balık ekmek in Istanbul. Under its name, my practical reminder reads, “Hold lunch first.”

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在伊斯坦布尔去加拉塔塔碰头时拐早了，我在便纸上留下自己的弯箭头，不是导航。
descriptions.en: My own curved arrow from turning too early on the way to a Galata Tower meeting in Istanbul. No navigational ambitions.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在伊斯坦布尔吃烤鱼三明治时，我发现纸占着双手，便给自己写了这张小提醒。
descriptions.en: A small personal reminder after paper occupied both hands during a fish-sandwich lunch in Istanbul.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 从伊斯坦布尔地下水宫出来后写的观察：自己挪了几步，柱子的重叠就变了。
descriptions.en: A note made outside Istanbul’s Basilica Cistern: a few steps changed how the columns overlapped.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在伊斯坦布尔，我把加拉塔塔旁终于碰头的记忆折进口袋卡。弯箭头记得我的路，也记得那次笑声。
descriptions.en: My Istanbul pocket card keeps a wrong turn and a successful Galata Tower meeting, with a curved arrow and a remembered laugh.
